Flow.description:
2026-09-14: AP: Disabled slack for testing 2026-09-15: AP - Straumann_Customer_Number is no longer required on the Handover Notes screen for every New Sales opp - made optional, matching how it already behaves in Add_Practices' own copy of this field, since not every practice has a Straumann relationship. 2026-09-15: AP - Removed the Welcome_Email__c collection (screen field + assignment) from Handover Notes. Onboarding_Point_of_Contact__c is now the sole mechanism going forward - reverses the 2026-09-10 design doc's original decision to keep both, after a 2026-09-15 review found Welcome_Email__c only 80.7% filled historically. Existing Onboarding records' Welcome_Email__c values are untouched.
2026-10-01: AP - Fixed pendingDeviceTypeFormula. Old formula checked Record_Type_Name__c = "Downgrade", but no Opportunity Record Type by that name exists (only New Sales, Expansion, Retention) - this was dead code, always returning blank. New formula maps New Sales -> "New Sale"; Expansion -> "New Sale" unless Type="Scanner Upgrade" (-> "Exchange"); Retention -> "Exchange" only when Type is known, blank when Type is also blank (Retention volume with unknown subtype should not be force-labeled). Part of Asset Assignments V2 sub-project 1 (OPS-288/OPS-33/OPS-346). | 2026-10-01 - Adam Pelc - Sandbox-only Slack bypass: New_Deal_Slack_Message was unconditionally crashing the flow in incisive-partial (Slack App A028VJ1KG3G is production-only, not authorized for this sandbox, and the action has no fault connector by the 2026-09-21 explicit decision to match production behavior). Added Get_Organization_Info + Is_Sandbox_Org decision so sandboxes skip the Slack call entirely; production path (including the absence of a fault connector) is completely unchanged. | 2026-10-01 - Adam Pelc - Revised pendingDeviceTypeFormula again: stop reusing "Exchange" for CS-Handover-created devices (Exchange is reserved for Account_Screenflow_Exchange_Scanner, the only path that populates Requested_Part__c - reusing it broke Device_Type__c/Product_ID__c/Product_Code__c, which assumed Type__c=Exchange always meant Requested_Part__c is populated). New mapping: Expansion/Scanner Upgrade -> new "Upgrade" picklist value (added to Type__c this session). Retention + Type known (except Full Save) -> existing, previously-unused "Downgrade" value. Retention + Full Save -> blank, no classification (explicit call - Full Save is not a downgrade, doesn't need one). Retention + blank Type -> blank, unchanged. requireFullBundleFormula in Asset_Assignment_Subflow_Screen_Assigned needs no change (still just checks = "New Sale"). 2026-10-13: AP - OPS-114 / OPS-426: Handover Notes screen now captures Desired Delivery Date (required, future dates only, saved to Onboarding.Desired_Delivery_Date__c) right below Onboarding Notes, and Partner Rep Org / Partner Rep Name above Straumann Customer Number (Name only shown and required once an Org is selected; both saved to the Opportunity via the new Update_Opportunity_Partner_Rep, between Update_Accounts and Create_Onboarding). New: choice set partnerRepOrgChoices, variables partnerRepOrgValue / partnerRepNameValue. A future-date check across all rows runs before Add_Notes_Loop (Check_Dates_Loop, Is_Desired_Date_Future, Any_Desired_Date_Invalid, Desired_Date_Error_Screen) because a repeater field cannot carry its own validation rule; Handover_Notes now goes to Check_Dates_Loop instead of straight to Add_Notes_Loop. Nothing removed. 2026-10-13: AP - OPS-421: New Sales and Expansion Slack posts now end with a month-to-date deal count line (deal #N this month, X new, Y expansion). Counts Closed Won Opportunities (not Onboardings) with CloseDate from the 1st of the month through today. Get_Organization_Info now goes to Needs_Deal_Count instead of straight to Is_Sandbox_Org; New Sales/Expansion run Get_New_Sales_Deals_MTD, Get_Expansion_Deals_MTD and Set_Deal_Count_Line, then rejoin at Is_Sandbox_Org. Each query has a fault path to Is_Sandbox_Org, so a failed query posts without the line. Retention posts are unchanged. The message template now ends with a line break plus dealCountLine, which is blank when there is no count. Nothing removed. 2026-10-14: AP - OPS-421: Fixed the count line showing "deal #0 (0 new, 0 expansion)". The text template read the 0 defaults because it was assigned in the same element that stored the counts. Set_Deal_Count_Line now only stores the counts and goes to a new assignment, Set_Deal_Count_Message, which sets dealCountLine from the template, then on to Is_Sandbox_Org. Nothing removed. 2026-10-19: AP - OPS-442: The New Sales and Expansion Slack post count block now reads "deal #N this month (X new, Y expansion, Z lab only)" plus a second line "scanners sold, scanners returned, deployed total (650 goal)". New Sales deals are split into new (not lab only) and lab only (Plan Type Lab-Only) with new query Get_Lab_Only_Deals_MTD. Scanners sold = Scanner-family product lines on the counted deals (Deal_Loop, Get_Scanner_Lines, Scanner_Line_Loop). Scanners returned = Asset Assignments Returned with a Return Date this month, limited to Scanner assets (Get_Returned_Assignments, Returned_Loop, Get_Returned_Scanner_Assets). Deployed = latest Snapshot Assets rows in a deployed status minus Lock 8 (Get_Latest_Snapshot, Get_Deployed_Snapshot_Rows, Get_Lock_8_Snapshot_Rows); the 650 goal is hard-coded in deployedSegment. Opportunities with Type = Exchange are no longer counted (all deal and scanner queries) and no Slack post is sent for them (Skip_Exchange rule in Needs_Deal_Count). If a scanner, return or snapshot query fails, Set_Deal_Count_Only_Message posts the deal count line alone. Retention posts, header, practice list, Equipment and Rep unchanged. Nothing removed. 2026-10-19: AP: Straumann_Customer_Number on Handover_Notes is now shown, and required, only when the practice row's Partner Rep Org is Straumann Group (still New Sales only); otherwise it is hidden. To stop a hidden field blanking an existing number, Account_Updates no longer assigns Straumann_Customer_Number__c; new decision Has_Straumann_Number and assignment Set_Straumann_Number do it only when a number was entered, and Account_Updates first resets accountToUpdate from new variable emptyAccount Retention posts, header, practice list, Equipment and Rep unchanged. Nothing removed. 2026-10-19: AP - OPS-450: Exchange opportunities now post to the inventory channel (mentions Kristina) when they go through CS Handover at Closed Won: "An exchange was closed won for Account by Rep - View Opportunity". The Skip_Exchange rule in Needs_Deal_Count now goes to new decision Is_Sandbox_Org_Exchange (sandboxes skip the post) then new action Exchange_Slack_Message; new formula opportunityLink and text template exchangeSlackMessage. Exchanges still get no deal count and are still left out of the counts. The normal New Sales / Expansion / Retention post is unchanged. Nothing removed. 2026-10-19: AP - OPS-442: Fixed the deployed total showing 10 instead of about 430. The snapshot rows are inserted in batches a second or two apart, so matching on the latest row's exact created time only counted the last batch. Get_Deployed_Snapshot_Rows and Get_Lock_8_Snapshot_Rows now match every row created on the latest snapshot's calendar day (UTC) using new formulas snapshotDayStart and snapshotDayEnd. Get_Latest_Snapshot is unchanged and only finds the day. Nothing removed.

formulas.name: monthStartDate
onboardingTypeFormula
formulas.expression: IF({!recordId.Record_Type_Name__c} = 'New Sales', 'New Sale', CASE(TEXT({!recordId.Type}), 'Scanner Downgrade', 'Scanner Downgrade', 'Non-Scanner Downgrade', 'Non-Scanner Downgrade', 'Scanner Upgrade', 'Scanner Upgrade', 'Churn','Churn', 'New Scanner', 'New Scanner', ''))

formulas.description: Lightning link to the opportunity being handed over, used in the Exchange Slack message.
formulas.name: opportunityLink
pendingDeviceTypeFormula
formulas.expression: IF({!recordId.Record_Type_Name__c} = "New Sales", "New Sale", IF(AND({!recordId.Record_Type_Name__c} = "Expansion", TEXT({!recordId.Type}) = "Scanner Upgrade"), "Upgrade", IF({!recordId.Record_Type_Name__c} = "Expansion", "New Sale", IF(AND({!recordId.Record_Type_Name__c} = "Retention", TEXT({!recordId.Type}) <> "Full Save", NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT({!recordId.Type})))), "Downgrade", ""))))

formulas.description: End of the latest snapshot's calendar day (the next 00:00 UTC). Rows created before this and from snapshotDayStart make up the latest snapshot.
formulas.name: snapshotDayEnd

formulas.description: Start of the latest snapshot's calendar day (00:00 UTC). Snapshot rows are inserted in batches a few seconds apart, so the whole day is matched instead of one exact created time.
formulas.name: snapshotDayStart
